name: Canadian Civic Numbers and Units
description: Civic numbers with suffixes, and unit numbers in every place Canada Post and common usage put them: before the civic number with a hyphen (4-123 Main St), with a designator before the pair, and after the street. A bare unit-civic pair reports secUnitType Unit. Shapes follow Canada Post's Addressing Guidelines, described in our own words; every input is constructed for this corpus, and no table is copied from Canada Post.
